6 - Ah-ooh-ooh-ooh-ooh-ooh-h: 
A + H = AH
AH + AH = Ooh
AH + Ooh = Ah-Ooh
Ah-Ooh + Ah-Ooh = Ah-ooh-ooh
Ah-ooh-ooh + Ah-ooh-ooh = Ah-ooh-ooh-ooh-ooh-ooh
Ah-ooh-ooh-ooh-ooh-ooh + H = Ah-ooh-ooh-ooh-ooh-ooh-h

6 - Burning Hills 90210H: 
A + Fire = B
B + H = BH
BH + Fire = BH90210
BH + BH90210 = Beverly Hills 90210
Beverly Hills 90210 + Fire = Burning Hills 90210
Burning Hills 90210 + H = Burning Hills 90210H
